summary: The proposed mechanism is a coupled evolutionary/geometric refinement process. Architecture diagrams, ablations and trajectories support contribution and plausibility, but they do not uniquely identify all learned causal pathways.

findings.statement: MSA information enters pair representations through outer-product operations, while pair bias feeds back into MSA attention; triangle updates encode consistency among residue relations.
findings.reason: This is the concrete information-flow mechanism claimed by the architecture.

cross_cutting_checks.counterfactual: Without bidirectional MSA/pair exchange, the proposed evolutionary-to-geometric mechanism would be altered.

findings.statement: Invariant point attention operates on local-frame points and supports rigid-motion-invariant iterative coordinate refinement.
findings.reason: The geometry is a mechanism, not merely an architectural label.

findings.statement: Ablation and trajectory evidence is consistent with IPA, recycling, triangle updates and depth contributing to accuracy, but does not prove a single mechanistic explanation.
findings.reason: Interventions support necessity within the trained design while leaving interaction and compensation questions open.

cross_cutting_checks.anomaly: ORF8 requires continued rearrangement whereas LmPR converges early, showing mechanism is target-dependent.
cross_cutting_checks.counterfactual: A separately retrained architecture could redistribute computation; the reported ablations are not a full causal intervention set.
